title: Org settings
description: Changes org-wide settings the way vCommander's Commission/Decommission do: enables custom roles, turns Global Site Admin on then off (it ends OFF), grants your account Access Control System/User Admin, allows face unlock, signs the LPR agreement and enables the LPR-related features. These changes are NOT undone.

steps.name: Grant yourself Access Control System Admin
Grant yourself Access Control User Admin
